verdict.rationale: LocalAI is a self-hosted runtime that serves models at localhost, so a data-training privacy question applies to it. However, nothing in the evidence pack states that user prompts or data are never sent off-machine or used for training, and no opt-out or privacy policy is documented. Local deployment alone is an architectural implication, not a documented guarantee, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
